newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Jan soymeal drops $10.00 limit on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Jan soymeal drops $10.00 limit on USDA data.

text.p: CBOT January soymeal dropped the $10.00 per ton trading limit on bearish input from USDA's October crop production report and supply/demand report before rebounding slightly off the lows, traders said.
USDA early Friday increased its forecast for 1996 U.S. soybean production to 2.346 billion bushels, up from the September outlook for 2.270 billion bushels.
At 0958 CDT, soymeal was $8.00 to $9.00 per ton lower, with October down $7.70 at $241.00 per ton and January down $9.30 at $231.70 a ton after falling the $10.00 limit to $231.00.
